svg.title: PRD Genie architecture  sequential pipeline with one branch
svg.desc: Input flows into a full-tier Requirement Extractor, then branches to a full-tier Gap Analyzer and a mini-tier PRD Generator. PRD Generator feeds a mini-tier Story Breakdown. Clarification questions and PRD plus user stories are terminal outputs. Re-runs start from the Extractor.

svg.text: Sequential pipeline · one branch after extraction · split-model (ADR-001, ADR-003, ADR-004)
